verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's evidence describes managed Kubernetes on bare-metal node pools, scaled by the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler, plus an Inference API for model deployments. Neither documents a serverless worker model or scale-to-zero. Node-pool autoscaling is an adjacent infrastructure control that still means managing instances, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances
